title: Malicious code in vite-utils-svg-icon (npm)
description: The npm package vite-utils-svg-icon contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected machine should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted device. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of the malicious software or control established by the attacker.
